attributes.residual: NONE for the signature work: sndFxInit was EXACT at baseline and is EXACT after, byte-identical. Defect (3) as recorded is NOT a defect and was deliberately left in place - see the refutation below. sndfx.c's gGameMode conversion set is EMPTY and correctly so: the file has exactly two gGameMode sites, the assignment (now `gGameMode = mode;`, no literal) and sndFxPaused()'s `gGameMode & 0x8000`, which is a GROUP-MASK test, not a mode-value comparison. include/game/gamemode.h defines no group-mask constant, and respelling that mask as MA_CREDITS (0x8000) would be semantically WRONG - it is a mask over the whole MA_* family, not that one member. Left raw deliberately. This is consistent with claim.gamemode-raw-site-inventory.20260831.v1, whose 16-TU list correctly does not include game/audio/sndfx. The unrelated `(handle & 0x1FFF) | 0x8000` at sndfx.c:555 is a voice-handle flag, not a mode.
attributes.scope: src/game/audio/sndfx.c ONLY (7 lines). Commit 6d78751af. attract.c was probed and REVERTED, left byte-identical to its committed state. Changes: sndFxInit(void* a, void* b) -> sndFxInit(s32 mode, s32 wave); `gGameMode = (s32)a;` -> `gGameMode = mode;` (nonsense cast deleted); `extern void* lbl_80344290;` -> `extern s32 lbl_80344290;` (resolves the pointer-vs-int conflict against attract.c:206's `extern int`); and a FOURTH defect found in the same sweep and fixed with them: sndfx.c:119 declared `extern void fn_80053D08(void* a, int b, int c)` while that function's real definition at gamemain.c:1782 is `s32 fn_80053D08(s32 wave, s32 mode, s32 loadResult)` - the declaration was corrected to match, which is also what forces sndFxInit's SECOND parameter to be s32 (callers pass -1/-2/-3, level/wave ids).
